note: Family-owned park on US-385 about 6 mi south of Deadwood in the Black Hills, beside its own trading post with fuel and a seasonal deli. Mostly back-in full-hookup sites with a few pull-throughs, 50-amp electric-only and dry sites, plus cabins and a lodge. ATV and snowmobile trails run next to the property and UTVs are rented on site; generators are not allowed. --Claude
